comment: I LOVE DR. RADI! She is attentive, gives great feedback and always tries to make her classes fun. There is a lot of reading and discussion, so if that's not your thing you won't like as much
Dr. Radi is great. She is very insightful and I am glad I took her FYS.

Dr. Radi is brilliant and such a kind human. She is very qualified to teach this course, both because of her fluency in French and her understanding of modernity. She is very focused on encouraging students to lead discussions, but not in a way that makes her seem unprepared for class. I learned so much from her and would definitely take her again!
i looooovvvveee lidia! she is the most passionate person i have ever met.

If you have a chance to learn Italian, take dr radi! She was literally my motivation to wake up. Class was super fun and interesting, it didn't even feel like school. She always makes sure you know what you're being tested on and teaches in engaging ways that make everyone understand the content.

Easily the best teacher I've had at Richmond. Not only does she care about her students, but she prides herself in fairness and I respect her so much for it. She was always looking to help and she made lectures fun and interesting by engaging us every day. She was also very accommodating when I was sick for example allowing me to make up work.

Professor Radi's class was pretty easy. Watching television shows or reading material, writing paragraphs, and then correcting those paragraphs in class. I wish class time was a bit more productive. Radi really cares about her students, though.

GREAT prof to have for French 305, teaches Italian too. Very dedicated and cares a lot about her students. I had trouble understanding what she was looking for in an essay at first, but once I got the hang of it, not bad at all. 4 short papers, fair amount of HW, but really cares about her students. Pretty engaging class, highly recommend to all.

Dr. Radi is a great professor. She teaches languages but pushes her students to find more meaning and relevance in what they're learning past just learning how to read/write/speak the language. She is also very understanding and communicative with students regarding extensions, missing class, etc. Her assignments are interesting and not busywork.

Dr. Radi is a brilliant professor! She gives incredibly helpful feedback and genuinely wants to see her students become better thinkers, writers, and humans. Dr. Radi's class definitely requires a fair amount of reading/homework, but the assignments are extremely helpful for understanding larger themes of the class. An incredible professor!

Dr. Radi is amazing. She is so passionate about what she does. My LLC class was based around class discussion, so definitely be prepared to contribute in class! But I learned so much about the world and wouldn't trade it for the world. And Dr. Radi truly fosters a learning environment in which students want to be more engaged and enthusiastic.

Dr. Radi is one of the hidden gems of the University of Richmond. She is a brilliant professor with a passion for language and culture. I took a Literature-based course with her, and she was an incredibly useful source and inspiration for me to improve my writing and literary criticism. Fantastic human being!

Dr. Radi is easily one of the best professors at UR. Extremely supportive, and loved by her students.  Her classes require some reading and active participation is necessary to do well.  Her teaching style is best suited for small advanced level classes.  Don't miss the opportunity to take a class taught by Radi!

Dr. Radi cares about her students and loves teaching. If you establish a good relationship with her then she will help you out. She does expect a lot from students in terms of homework and staying on top of assignments, but admits she doesn't like giving tests or bad grades.

I took Radi for an intensive course so there was a lot of assigned homework each night.  Cares about her students and wants them to not only pass the class but love Italian.  If you respect her she will show you the same back.  If you put in the effort, an easy A, even for an intensive language course.

I have mixed feelings about Radi. I like classes where I know if I work hard enough, I can get an A. Then I don't worry about the grade and enjoy learning. This wasn't one of those classes. She has one sided interpretations and finds contradictions in places that don't exist. I did learn though and she's a great person and a decent teacher.

Dr. Radi is an amazing professor! She is extremely passionate and wants to make sure everyone understands what is going on in the class discussion. She is open to improvement and encourages creative criticism when it comes to bettering her teaching. I had her multiple times and she was always great.

Such a wonderful teacher!!! She is my favorite teacher at Richmond. So helpful and so supportive. Is so passionate about the content she is teaching so it really draws you in. I can not say enough good things about her!!

Although this class was more difficult than anticipated, Prof. Radi was the best teacher of all my classes. She genuinely cares for each student and is always willing to help if you ask her. She cares more for the quality of learning you absorb from class, rather than the quantity (grades) so make sure you attend class. Highly recommended!

Dr. Radi is wonderful! Class is difficult, but she is extremely passionate about the subject. This class is A LOT of analyzing and discussion, and she assigns a lot of reading. She is not the hardest grader, which makes up for the difficulty of the class. She is a great professor, I highly recommend you take her class!

Class is far too difficult for a low 300 class. She expects every word you say to be incredibly insightful and philosophical. Genuinely wants to be "that" professor that you will say changed your life, for better or worse. Wants you to see life in a new way. Class is demanding linguistically for such a low level. not much writing, lots of reading

She is so excited about teaching the material and it shows...nicest professor ever.  she had us all over to her house and cooked for us.  she TRULY wants to see everyone do well and retain something from the class. take her, hands down best in the department.
TAKE HER CLASS.

Prof. Radi is one of the best professors at UR. Definitely take her class if you get the chance! She really cares about her students and gives a very manageable amount of work. She is very entertaining in class and she works hard to capture her student's attention. Very fair grader and understanding. GREAT PROF!
No Comments
